answer: Charge admission against one physical anchor: a chip of basalt that an agent can present only once. The fee is the running delta of clones already tied to that chip: the first key posts one unit, the next posts two, and every later key posts one unit more than the one before it. An attacker who mints extra identities therefore meets a steeper bill on the same anchor, while an umber seal burned into the receipt stops the chip proof from being replayed under a fresh name.
